note: Era 1 'Yellow Turbans' road data (docs/spec/16-roguelike-era1.md). Seed for src/data/eras/ and src/data/stops/ in RL1. All prose is our own paraphrase of the novel. Numbers tuned by tools/roguelike/paper-sim.mjs (docs/spec/16-roguelike-era1-sim.md).

zhou-cang.name: Zhou Cang
zhou-cang.alt: novel ch. 28 (joins Guan Yu years later)

liao-hua.name: Liao Hua
liao-hua.alt: novel ch. 27 (joins Guan Yu years later)

tiers.name: Youzhou
tiers.note: owner 2026-11-01: Daxing Hill is always a battle (the novel's first fight and the tutorial)

dayTable.label: very early
dayTable.text: You arrived on day {day}: the palisade is a line of stakes, its north archers are not posted and Zhang Liang's levies are still in the villages.

dayTable.label: early
dayTable.text: You arrived on day {day}: the palisade is half built and its north archers are not yet posted.

dayTable.label: on time
dayTable.text: You arrived on day {day}: the palisade stands complete.

dayTable.label: late
dayTable.text: You arrived on day {day}: the palisade is complete and Zhang Liang's levies march in on round 4.

dayTable.label: very late
dayTable.text: You arrived on day {day}: a second levy arrives on round 7, and Zhang Bao has had time to gather his storm (he begins with 6 Qi).

dayTable.label: too late
dayTable.text: You arrived on day {day}: Zhang Jiao's last rite is done. The yellow sky hangs over the field (every rebel adept's hex +20 confuse chance) and both levies come.

renown.text: Renown {renown} (60+): the villages round Guangzong send a militia company to your line.
Renown {renown} (80+): two rebel captains have heard of you and waver (loyalty -20).
Renown {renown} (under 20): the imperial generals keep one company back from a lord with such a name.

qingzhou-holds.text: Because your rice reached Qingzhou: Governor Gong Jing sends a company of his garrison to Guangzong.

qingzhou-fell.text: Because Qingzhou fell: its besiegers have joined Zhang Liang (+1 rebel unit).

village-fell.text: Because you marched past the burning village: its raiders wait at Guangzong (+1 rebel unit).

refugees-guided.text: Because you sheltered the refugees: their men know the north ford, and one of your units may start on the far bank.

turncoats.text: Because you spared the deserters: Captain Zhou of the sortie is their cousin (loyalty -20).

no-quarter.text: Because you executed the deserters: the rebels expect no mercy (no rebel can be swayed; their captains' loyalty becomes null).

granary-burned.text: Because you burned the granary: Zhang Liang fields 2 fewer units.

lu-zhi-freed.text: Because you freed Lu Zhi: his old officers lead a company of his veterans beside you.

outlaw.text: The court calls you outlaws: imperial camps give you no rice and Huangfu Song will not wait for you.

lu-zhi-letter.text: Because you eased Lu Zhi's road: his letter reached the imperial camp; the imperial guests begin with +2 Qi.

zhang-fei-sulks.text: Zhang Fei has not forgiven you for Lu Zhi's cart: he ignores your first order (he starts the battle confused).

rout-unchecked.text: Because Dong Zhuo's rout went unchecked: the rebels who chased him have joined Zhang Liang (+1 rebel unit).

dong-zhuo-grudge.text: Word of the shouting in Dong Zhuo's tent has reached Zhu Jun: his commissary gives you half.

blood-ward.text: Because you carried the blood ward: Zhang Bao's Call the Storm costs 8 Qi and lasts 1 round.

zhang-bao-wounded.text: Because your night raid struck the altar: Zhang Bao starts with 60% of his troops.

zhu-jun-line.text: Because you served in Zhu Jun's line: one of his companies fights beside you.

huangfu-column.text: Because you waited for Huangfu Song: two of his companies form your left wing.

stockade-burned.text: Because your raiders fired the stockade: the palisade is as it would be four days earlier.

forged-weapons.text: The brothers carry their forged weapons: Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei have War +4 for the run.

stops.title: The Notice at Zhuo
scene: A Han notice on the Zhuo county wall calls for men to fight the Yellow Turbans. Liu Bei, a straw-sandal seller of imperial blood, sighs in front of it; a black-whiskered butcher scolds him for sighing instead of acting.
In the wine shop a towering red-faced stranger joins them. Under the peach blossom behind Zhang Fei's farm the three swore to be brothers. Now the oath needs men and grain.

choices.label: Zhang Fei sells his farm and his butcher's stall
choices.tension: The biggest early army, but every man eats from day one.

choices.label: Open the peach garden to the county and read the oath aloud
choices.tension: Spend scarce rice for a name that pays at every town.

choices.label: Take the county's grain levy and press its idle young men
choices.tension: A full cart and a bigger band now, and a poorer name everywhere after.

stops.title: The Horse Dealers of Zhongshan
scene: Two horse dealers from Zhongshan, Zhang Shiping and Su Shuang, are stuck in Zhuo with their herd: the rebels hold the roads north.
They have heard about the oath, and they come to the camp to look the brothers over.

choices.label: Accept their horses, steel and silver, and forge the brothers' weapons
choices.tension: A day at the forge and a smaller rice gift, for brothers who hit harder all run long.

choices.label: Escort the herd through the rebel country
choices.tension: Two days and a stated risk for the biggest rice haul of the early road.

choices.label: Take the herd for the war and sell it to the Youzhou quartermaster
choices.tension: Rice without days, paid for in name.

stops.title: Daxing Hill
scene: Cheng Yuanzhi's turbaned host is marching on Zhuo. The Youzhou magistrate Zou Jing has few trained men, and he gladly takes the brothers' band into his column.
The rebels have camped in the millet below Daxing Hill. The wind is from the west.

choices.label: March with Zou Jing to Daxing Hill
choices.tension: The first real fight costs men and a battle's rice, and it brings Jian Yong and a name.

choices.label: Burn the rebel supply carts and the farms they camp in the night before, then fight
choices.tension: A day, a stated risk and a stain, for more rice and a weaker enemy; you fight either way.

stops.title: Qingzhou Besieged
scene: A rider from Governor Gong Jing: Qingzhou's walls are ringed with rebels and its granary is down to husks.
Zou Jing will lend his archers if Liu Bei leads. The rebels outnumber you; the only way in is to make them chase you.

choices.label: Relieve Qingzhou: feign a retreat and spring the brothers from the ridges
choices.tension: The hardest early battle for the biggest early reward.

choices.label: Run rice through the siege lines by night
choices.tension: No battle, rice spent on an ally you may see again, at stated odds.

choices.label: Leave Qingzhou to its walls and march south
choices.tension: Free now; what happens to Qingzhou is not shown.

stops.title: A Village Under Siege
scene: Smoke over a millet village: a rebel band has fired the threshing floor, and the elders have barred the gate with carts.
Women are on the walls with hoes. They have seen your banner.

choices.label: Break the siege
choices.tension: A small battle's losses and rice, for name, rice and men.

choices.label: Send Zhang Fei with a hundred men
choices.tension: Cheap, but a hurt Zhang Fei leads half his men until you rest.

choices.label: March past
choices.tension: Costs nothing today but the name; what the raiders do next is not shown.

stops.title: The Refugee Column
scene: A column of families from the burned counties, carts and grandmothers and goats, begs to march under the Han banner.
They have eaten their seed grain. The road south is long.

choices.label: Take them in
choices.tension: Slower and hungrier, for men and a name.

choices.label: Give them rice and send them on
choices.tension: Name for rice, no delay.

choices.label: Take the young men and send the rest on
choices.tension: Men now, name lost.

stops.title: The Deserters
scene: Six hundred Yellow Turbans throw down their spears at your pickets. Their scarves are filthy and their bellies are empty.
Zou Jing's standing order is no quarter. One of them, a young officer named Liao Hua, asks to speak to Liu Bei.

choices.label: Spare them and enlist them
choices.tension: More mouths, and rebels in the ranks; a good name brings an officer.

choices.label: Disarm them and send them home with a sack each
choices.tension: Name for rice, no men.

choices.label: Carry out the order and take their sacks
choices.tension: Rice and safety now.

stops.title: The Empty County
scene: The magistrate of a small county fled at the first rumour of rebels. His granary is sealed, his fields are ripe and nobody is cutting them.
The farmers watch your column from their doorways.

choices.label: Break the granary seal and press the young men
choices.tension: The ruthless road in one choice.

choices.label: Bring in the harvest with them for a fair share
choices.tension: Two days of work for rice, a name and willing men.

stops.title: The Flooded Ford
scene: The autumn rains have filled the river to its banks. The ferryman's rope is gone, and the far bank is a smudge in the drizzle.

choices.label: Wait for the water to fall
choices.tension: Safe; two days of rice and two days nearer the finished palisade.

choices.label: Cross now
choices.tension: Stated odds against time.

choices.label: Pull the doors off the nearest village for rafts
choices.tension: Half the delay, a little name.

stops.title: Zhou Cang's Pass
scene: A band of hill bandits, once Yellow Turbans, blocks the pass road under two chiefs: Pei Yuanshao, and a dark giant named Zhou Cang who says he has heard of Guan Yu.
Zhou Cang would kneel to a lord worth following. Both of them would take a toll from one who isn't.

choices.label: Ask Zhou Cang to join you (Renown 40+)
choices.tension: Men and an officer who eat; only a lord of name can ask, otherwise he names a toll.

choices.label: Clear the pass by force
choices.tension: A fight for their hoard and a free road.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.tension: The cheap peace: rice for a whole skin and an open road.

stops.title: The Fires at Changshe
scene: At Changshe the rebels camped in tall grass, and Huangfu Song set it alight on a night wind. The plain is a sea of fire.
Rebels run in every direction. A red-bannered troop of horse under a young officer named Cao Cao is cutting them down.

choices.label: Ride with Cao Cao and take the baggage
choices.tension: Rice at stated odds.

choices.label: Cut firebreaks round the villages in the fire's path
choices.tension: A day and no loot, for name and men.

choices.label: Gather the grain the rebels dropped
choices.tension: Rice for a day.

stops.title: The Rebel Granary
scene: A walled rebel granary, its guards fled, the wagons still yoked. Starving farmers watch from the ditch.
It is a long haul to Guangzong with full wagons.

choices.label: Load the wagons
choices.tension: The biggest rice haul, three days slower.

choices.label: Burn it so Guangzong never eats it
choices.tension: Nothing now, a weaker finale.

choices.label: Open it to the starving
choices.tension: Name and men, no rice.

stops.title: Lu Zhi in Chains
scene: A prison cart on the Guangzong road. Inside sits Lu Zhi, Liu Bei's old teacher: he would not bribe the court's envoy, so the envoy reported him for cowardice.
Zhang Fei already has his spear in his hand.

choices.label: Free him from the escort
choices.tension: Honour and a finale ally, but the court calls you outlaws.

choices.label: Pay the escort to treat him gently
choices.tension: Rice for a quiet favour.

choices.label: Let the law take its course
choices.tension: No battle and no rice; the men see you do nothing, and Zhang Fei will remember.

stops.title: Dong Zhuo's Rout
scene: Dust on the plain: an imperial army in full rout, with Zhang Jiao's host on its heels.
The general in the middle of the flight is Dong Zhuo of Hedong, and he is losing.

choices.label: Charge into the rebels' flank
choices.tension: A real battle for a man who will not thank you, though some of his stragglers will.

choices.label: Shadow the rout and take what it drops
choices.tension: Rice now, a stain on the name, and the rebels who won here go on to Guangzong.

stops.title: Dong Zhuo's Snub
scene: Back in his camp, Dong Zhuo asks what rank the brothers hold. Hearing 'none', he turns back to his wine without a word of thanks.
Zhang Fei's hand goes to his sword hilt.

choices.label: Hold Zhang Fei back and take your leave
choices.tension: Name, and a brooding brother.

choices.label: Let Zhang Fei say his piece, and take the spare rice as thanks
choices.tension: Rice and a fierce brother, and the story travels.

stops.title: Fever in the Camp
scene: A fever comes off the marshes and runs through the ranks.
At the camp's edge, hedge priests of the Way of Great Peace sell charm water by the cup.

choices.label: Quarantine the sick and wait it out
choices.tension: A day for a light toll.

choices.label: March through it
choices.tension: No days, many men, and a tired army.

choices.label: Buy the charm water
choices.tension: Stated odds and a stain on the name.

stops.title: Rest or Push On
scene: The men's sandals are worn through after the hill roads. There is a dry riverbed for a camp and a farmer's orchard beside it.
Guangzong will not wait.

choices.label: Rest two days
choices.tension: Two days of rice and two days at Guangzong, for whole men and fresh spirit.

choices.label: Forced march
choices.tension: Spare rice and days, lose men.

choices.label: Rest a day and strip the orchard
choices.tension: A little of each.

stops.title: The Inspector
scene: For their service the brothers are given a small county, Anxi. The court's inspector arrives, sneers at Liu Bei for bringing no gift, and threatens to report him.
Zhang Fei finds the inspector drunk at the post-house and ties him to the hitching post.

choices.label: Let Zhang Fei flog him, hang your seal of office on his neck and go
choices.tension: Name, a fierce Zhang Fei and the county's young men, but no county grain and no court favour.

choices.label: Cut him down and pay him from the county granary
choices.tension: Rice and a post, at the cost of Zhang Fei's spirit and the name.

stops.title: Zhu Jun's Camp
scene: General Zhu Jun's imperial camp is a city of tents. He offers the band a place in his line against the last rebel strongholds, and a share of the commissary.
Wancheng's rebels still hold out to the south.

choices.label: Serve in Zhu Jun's line
choices.tension: Two days of parades for rice and a finale ally; outlaws get nothing.

choices.label: Lead the storming party at Wancheng
choices.tension: The stated-odds glory road.

choices.label: Trade your spare horses for rice
choices.tension: Rice without days, and Guan Yu leads fewer riders.

stops.title: Zhang Bao's Sorcery
scene: Captives from Zhang Bao's camp tell of black wind and paper soldiers falling from the sky.
Liu Bei remembers an old counter-charm: the blood of pigs, goats and dogs poured on the heights.

choices.label: Buy the beasts and carry the blood ward
choices.tension: A day and rice to blunt the finale's sorcery.

choices.label: Raid the altar hill tonight
choices.tension: Stated odds on a weaker sorcerer.

choices.label: Leave the sorcerer to the generals
choices.tension: No days, no rice, no risk; the sorcerer keeps his full strength.

stops.title: The Eve of Guangzong
scene: Guangzong's palisade rises on the far bank of the river; you can hear the mallets in the dark.
Huangfu Song's column is two days behind you.

choices.label: Wait for Huangfu Song (not open to outlaws)
choices.tension: Two days of stockade-building for an ally; outlaws wait for nothing.

choices.label: Send raiders to fire the stockade
choices.tension: Stated odds on a weaker palisade.

choices.label: Cross at dawn
choices.tension: No days lost, nothing gained.
